test_function_coverage: test that all Mujoco functions are either bound in bindings.cc or excluded in constants.py
test_struct_coverage: test that all Mujoco structs are either bound in bindings.cc or listed in SKIPPED_STRUCTS
run_binding_coverage_test: run the BindingCoverageTest to verify WASM bindings completeness
review_bound_functions: review the functions extracted from bindings.cc using regex pattern matching
review_bound_structs: review the structs extracted from bindings.cc using regex pattern matching
